Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) /
        NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(prm_amt.Policy_Amount), 0), 0)
        AS decimal(18,6)
    ) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN Premium prm
    ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN Policy_Amount prm_amt
    ON prm_amt.Policy_Amount_Identifier = prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier
   AND prm_amt.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,

    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,

LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?

SELECT
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
INNER JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
INNER JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
INNER JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd

   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy p

   OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL

Question: What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?

What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?
Generated Query:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cc.Effective_Date,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        cc.Effective_Date,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT
        Effective_Date,
        Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
        SUM(loss_payment + loss_reserve + expense_payment + expense_reserve) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_totals
    GROUP BY
        Effective_Date,
        Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(pl.number_of_claims, 0) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(pl.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) AS premium,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(pl.total_loss, 0) / pp.premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_loss pl
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pl.Policy_Identifier
   AND (
        pl.Effective_Date = pp.Effective_Date
